observations.value: Decision (accepted Oct 12, 2026): the files API headers X-LXD-uid, -gid, -mode, -type and -modified go into the attestor's minimal API contract and [V:L1] is removed; file_pull expects uid 0 in every instance class, since LXD reports the in-container owner everywhere; UID translation becomes a fallback; volatile.idmap.current matches the guest's uid_map, so it is a usable source. Evidence: runs 20261012T181538Z-g-l1-* (with their util idmap check records).
